01 / 07
  1. 01

    Find Your Perfect Match

    Browse through a pool of experienced and pre-screened babysitters in your area. Our advanced matching algorithm ensures you connect with the perfect caregiver for your child's unique needs.

  2. 02

    Secure and Verified

    Rest easy knowing that every babysitter on CareConnect undergoes a thorough background check and verification process, ensuring the highest standards of safety and professionalism.

  3. 03

    Easy Booking and Scheduling

    Schedule babysitters effortlessly with our intuitive calendar and booking system. Set your preferences, choose from available caregivers, and confirm bookings with just a few taps.

  4. 04

    Real-Time Updates

    Receive instant notifications about your booking status, including when the babysitter arrives and departs. Our GPS tracking feature provides an extra layer of security, giving you peace of mind throughout the entire childcare experience.

  5. 05

    Transparent Ratings and Reviews

    Build trust within our community by sharing your experiences. Rate and review babysitters based on their performance, and read feedback from other parents to make informed decisions.

  6. 06

    Secure Payments

    Our integrated payment system ensures hassle-free transactions. Pay for services, add tips, and manage your payment history—all within the app.

  7. 07

    Emergency Assistance

    Auntie prioritizes safety. In case of emergencies, babysitters have access to a panic button, and parents receive immediate alerts. Plus, easily access emergency contact information for swift communication.

Why Choose Auntie?

Auntie seeks to create a community of reliable, high quality childcare options for families and caregivers. Auntie was created to streamline and elevate finding and booking childcare for everyone involved with a focus on safety, reliability and care.

Contact Us
  1. 01

    Find

    Users can browse a database of qualified and vetted babysitters available in their local area. This might involve filtering based on criteria such as location, availability, experience, and user reviews.

  2. 02

    Book

    Once a suitable babysitter is identified, the user can easily book their services through the platform. This may involve selecting specific dates and times for babysitting, and some platforms may offer real-time availability.

  3. 03

    Pay

    The payment process is typically integrated into the platform, allowing users to securely pay for the babysitting services online. This may involve various payment methods, such as credit cards or digital wallets.

SAFETY IS OUR TOP PRIORITY

SERVICES

The Auntie App offers a range of childcare options to best fit the needs of your family. From daily Nannies, recurring weekly babysitters or that unscheduled need by 4pm TODAY, because your boss called an all hands meeting during pick up time, the Auntie App has you and your family covered!

01 / 04

Baby Sitter

Babysitters often communicate with parents during the caregiving period, providing updates on the children's activities and any notable occurrences.

02 / 04

Nanny

Regular communication with parents is essential. Nannies provide updates on the children's activities, development, and any concerns or milestones.

03 / 04

Nurse

Nurses are responsible for a wide range of healthcare tasks, including administering medications, monitoring vital signs, assisting with medical procedures, providing patient education, and coordinating patient care.

04 / 04

Other Services

Babysitters may need to prepare simple meals, ensure the children follow bedtime routines, and be prepared to handle common challenges that may arise.
